g.text: ONE AUTHORITY CHAIN / DURABLE RECOVERY / FINAL DELEGATION

text.tspan: Concurrent phases / reply loss / restart schedules
Composed reachability / original obligations / no replay
Lost reply resolves the same record
Serialize with seal at the writer
Unknown never becomes a fresh range
May drain across seal and restart
